sources.entry: MacTools - Open-source menu bar toolkit with plugins for display controls, system toggles, cleanup, device status, and everyday utilities. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/ggbond268/MacTools) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon] ![Native App][Native Icon]

summary.one_liner: MacTools is a free, open-source, native macOS menu bar toolkit that bundles plugins for displays, system toggles, cleanup, device status, and everyday utilities.
summary.what_it_does: MacTools puts customizable panels in the macOS menu bar, where each panel can mix live widgets, quick controls, and feature rows that you can drag to rearrange. A plugin marketplace in Settings lets you install and update plugins, with their settings and shortcuts in one place. A Command Palette (⌘K or a global shortcut) searches actions, settings, workflows, and plugins, and a Window Switcher, Clipboard History (with encrypted local storage, snippets, and paste queues), and screenshot tools (annotation, OCR, QR recognition, scrolling capture, region recording) are included. Other areas covered in the README include display brightness and resolution, audio and power controls, disk and cleanup utilities, system monitoring such as power wattage and battery health, automation workflows triggered by schedule or events, and preferences export/import. An experimental mactools CLI with JSON output is available in Nightly builds on Apple silicon.
use_cases: replace multiple menu bar utilities with one app
control display brightness and resolution from the menu bar
keep a searchable encrypted clipboard history
take and annotate screenshots with OCR
monitor Mac battery, power, and system performance
clean up disk space and manage login items
automate actions with schedules or app triggers
how_to_run: Or download the app from GitHub Releases
Open MacTools, then choose plugins in Settings → Marketplace
Arrange menu bar panels; grant permissions as prompted
notable: Plugin-based design with a built-in marketplace and customizable menu bar panels
Command Palette and Window Switcher with multiple modes (Search Select, Cycle, Direct Key)
Clipboard History with encrypted local storage, snippets, and paste queues
Theme support including iTerm2 and Base16/Base24 imports
Experimental mactools CLI with JSON output for scripts and AI agents (Nightly, Apple silicon)
caveats: Requires macOS 14 or later; some plugins need newer macOS versions or compatible hardware
Region recording and per-app volume require macOS 15+
CLI is an experimental Nightly feature on Apple silicon only; stable releases do not yet offer managed CLI installation
